tbesh_html:
1) to be or become many, be or become much, be or become great
1a)(Qal)
1a1) to be or become many
1a2) to be or become great
1a3) to be long (of journey)
2) (Pual) ten thousands

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to cast together , i.e. increase, especially in number; to multiply by the myriad
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; (compare H7241 (רָבִיב)); also as denominative from H7233 (רְבָבָה);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: increase, be many(-ifold), be more, multiply, ten thousands.
